reading_text:
The hand before me reveals much about your nature and potential. The head line, with its slight downward slope, suggests a proclivity for imaginative pursuits over the purely practical. This inclination is further nuanced by the head line's origin, which rises from the life line, indicating a sensitive and nervous temperament. Such a disposition may lead you to exercise excessive caution, even when your abilities are considerable.

Your life line is long, narrow, and deep, unmarred by irregularities. This is a promising sign of longevity, robust health, and vitality. The well-developed Mount of Venus further supports this, indicating strong and robust health.

Ambition and a desire for power are evident in the developed Mount of Jupiter. This feature also points to pride and enthusiasm in your endeavors. Additionally, the presence of the Upper Mount of Mars suggests you possess active courage and a martial spirit. Together, these elements paint a picture of a person with both the imagination and the drive to pursue their ambitions with vigor.

A note on what I have not interpreted: the classical texts I work from do not clearly address the following as they appear in your hands: heart line, fate line, sun line, thumb, fingers, mount of saturn, mount of apollo, mount of mercury, mount of mars negative, mount of luna. Rather than guess, I have left these out of your reading.

For major life decisions, I recommend consulting a qualified astrologer or palm reader for a personal reading.

A head line rising from the commencement of the life line, and connected with it, indicates a sensitive and more nervous temperament, with an excess of caution that leads even clever people to hold themselves back too tightly.

The line of head from the commencement of the line of life, and connected with it (d-d, Plate XVI.), indicates a sensitive and more nervous temperament; it denotes excess of caution; even clever people with this mark rein themselves down too tightly.
The line of life should be long, narrow, and deep, without irregularities, breaks, or crosses of any kind. Such a formation promises long life, good health, and vitality.
Venus be well developed, it indicates strong and robust health.
